notes: *were* placed on the first numeral of the predicate שֵׁשׁ (discontinuous under rule 25); the ASV writes it beside *four and twenty*, so a reader could prefer it on עֶשְׂרִים or אַרְבַּע.

*fingers and toes* read as one rendering of אֶצְבְּעֹת with its internal *and* (rule 14 closing sentence); *great* in *of great stature* read as the ASV's completion of מִדָּה's idiomatic lexeme (rule 31), not added.
*on each hand* and *on each foot* are two added units because the rendered waw and second שֵׁשׁ stand between them (rule 2).
